# reference authority

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:referenceAuthority`](gmeow-referenceAuthority.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/referenceAuthority>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The cadastral registry, land titles office, or surveying authority that issued this reference. Functional: a single reference has exactly one issuing authority.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CadastralReference`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReference.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single registry or surveying authority that issued a cadastral reference; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid multiple authorities per reference.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:referenceAuthority`](gmeow-referenceAuthority.md) (an [`Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)) per [`CadastralReference`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReference.md).
